title: 7-Day Technology Accelerator & Project Championship
summary: Learn seven technologies through live training, guided mini-projects and a final project challenge.
listingIntro: A practical introduction to seven technologies with guided mini-projects and a final project championship.
detailIntro: A structured seven-day learning experience: learn concepts, practise techniques, build mini-projects, integrate your work and present a project.
projectDescription: The presentation proposes an integrated career platform as a project championship concept. Students learn technologies, create individual projects and combine their work into a larger idea.
scopeHeading: A practical introduction, built through guided projects
scopeDescription: Seven days is an ambitious pace. The program is best understood as a guided introduction to seven technologies with starter projects, rather than mastery of seven professional disciplines.
scheduleDescription: The timetable lists daily sessions from 6 PM to 9 PM IST. It allocates one hour to hands-on practice and 40 minutes to mini-project development each day. Another slide describes approximately 3–4 hours daily, so the final daily commitment needs confirmation.
sessionNote: The remaining agenda and exact daily time breakdown need confirmation.
offeringsIntro: A week of live learning, guided project work and a chance to bring the technology tracks together.

offerings.title: Seven live sessions
offerings.text: Spend seven days exploring one technology track at a time with live training.

offerings.title: Guided mini-projects
offerings.text: Make a starter output each day, from a Python mini-project and web app to a hosted application and analytics dashboard.

offerings.title: One integrated project
offerings.text: Bring the week's learning together through the proposed AI-powered student career platform concept.

offerings.title: Project championship
offerings.text: Present an integrated project in the championship. The presentation advertises a ₹20,000 prize pool; rules and judging details are still to come.

offerings.title: Certificate opportunity
offerings.text: The presentation lists seven certificates, conditional on completion. Attendance and assessment criteria are still being finalized.

registrationStatus: The schedule and participation terms are being finalized. The advertised fee is ₹999 and the dates remain tentative. Final details will be confirmed before payment is accepted.
